terms.intro: These terms govern the use of TCM Self-Check — the web app in its closed beta, the practitioner reference skill and the printed editions (together, “the services”) — provided by the TCM Self-Check project (“the project”). By using the services you accept these terms; if you do not accept them, do not use the services.
terms.s1.p1: The services are for the project's internal doctors, learners and candidate users whom the project has invited, for study and for use within the project only. They are not offered to the public and are not for use outside the project.
terms.s1.p2: To accept these terms you must be at least 18 years old and able to agree to them.

terms.s2.p1: The services are an educational reference built on traditional Chinese medicine theory and a draft knowledge base. They do not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, they are not a medical device, and using them creates no relationship between a practitioner and a patient.
terms.s2.p2: In an emergency, call your local emergency number at once.

terms.s3.p1: The medical content — patterns, formulas, herb records, reference quantities and the rules that work from them — has not yet been reviewed by qualified TCM practitioners or pharmacists. It may contain errors, and it changes as the project works.
terms.s3.p2: Reference quantities are for study and as an aid to a practitioner only, never instructions for taking medicine.

terms.s4.p1: The practitioner role and the practitioner reference skill give a reference to check your own judgement against. You remain solely responsible for the examination, for the decision and for every herb and quantity you give, and for following the laws and professional rules of the place where you practise.
terms.s4.p2: Enter nothing that identifies a patient: no name, identity or chart number, date of birth, address or telephone number. When you use the skill in Claude, what you describe is processed by Claude's provider under your own agreement with it; make sure the rules of your workplace allow that.
terms.s4.title: For practitioners
terms.s5.p1: Use the services for study and within the project only. Do not give access to them, their outputs or the printed editions to anyone outside the project, publish them, or present them as reviewed, as the project's advice, or as a prescription.
terms.s5.p2: Do not use the services to harm anyone or to break their security. Report safety concerns and security problems to the project (SECURITY.md).

terms.s6.p1: The app keeps what you enter on your own device and uploads nothing — except where you choose AI help in a development build, as the app's privacy statement explains. You are responsible for your device and for the backup files you make.
